name: spaces
description: Space scaffold — the thin per-space frontend the Tauri webview loads for `--app=<id>` windows. NO hub code (no marketplace/settings/auth/studio): the deck router mounts <ship-space-shell>, a config-driven shell that reads the space settings (scope=SPACE) and composes its chrome regions (nav/rail/dock) from config, mounts the always-on cmdk + search platform layer, and renders the active route in the view outlet. Built by `deck build` (deck-cli) into .deck/.
